cases.title: Client with conflicting source documents (DOCX + XLSX + CSV)
cases.pipeline: stage 2 builders → isolated ingestion worker → stage 3 deterministic suggestions → conflict rule (TS mirror of the SQL rule)

detail: 2 seeded conflicts (price, Monday hours) must be flagged; 1 seeded agreement (phone in DOCX and CSV) must not be

cost.live: AI reading of the same files in a build ≈ $1–2 for a 10-file adversarial set at medium effort

cases.title: Image edit with strong product preservation (protected label)
cases.pipeline: stage 5 verify → normalise → fake model output → protected-region compositing (sharp, lossless)

detail: the fake model output alters the label; compositing must restore every label pixel exactly

cost.live: worst planned edit call $0.243 (OpenAI, 3 input images); instruction step ≤ $0.119 (Anthropic)
cost.plan: image edit qualification: 24 edit calls + 3 end-to-end ≈ $5.83 + $0.36, allowance $6.50 OpenAI + $0.50 Anthropic
